ui.title: Tesla Delivery Checklist
ui.subtitle: Car inspection on delivery day
ui.privacy: This app does not transmit any data: everything stays on this device only. No analytics and no network calls, other than loading the app itself.
ui.customEmpty: No custom fields. Add, for example, centre, advisor or mileage.
ui.notePh: Describe the issue or add a note…
ui.noIssues: No issues marked. If you find a problem, mark it as “Issue” and it will appear here.
ui.resetConfirm: Delete the ENTIRE form (marks, notes, plate, VIN and custom fields)? This cannot be undone.
ui.pdfHint: The print dialog will open: choose “Save as PDF”.
ui.addedHint: Item added to the original list
ui.credit: List based on the checklist by EdaL (Enrique DC) at Pedidos Tesla.
ui.saveFail: ⚠ Cannot save on this device (storage full, blocked or private mode). Your data is NOT being saved: generate the PDF or take screenshots before closing.
ui.disclaimer: Not affiliated with Tesla, Inc. This is only a help and suggestion guide: the authors accept no responsibility for anything, including decisions made, undetected defects, errors or omissions, or use of this information. Always confirm with Tesla and official sources.

prep.i: Before looking at the car: it is yours, as ordered, with the paperwork in order.

ext.i: Walk fully around the vehicle, then check every seat and compartment.

func.i: Test the functions installed in your vehicle, using the manual as reference.

tech.i: Check access, connectivity, charging and the accessories of your order.

end.i: Record what is pending and keep a copy together with your photos.

grp.g-ship: Shipping by sea to another island (if applicable)

prep.x: Charged phone, powerful LED torch, pen and, if you like, nitrile gloves.
A second person looks with a cooler head and helps with brake and reverse lights.
Bring ID card, driving licence, insurance and the papers from section 1. Download the documents from your Tesla account.
Inspect in good light and photograph each finding, close up and showing where it is.
You can inspect the car before formally accepting it. Run your hand over surfaces and gaps and test everything.

after.x: If you notice vibrations (wheel, pedals or armrest), set pressures to the car label values and open a ticket in the app to check alignment and balancing.
Distance purchases usually carry a withdrawal period (14 days in the EU). Check Tesla Portugal's conditions in your contract.

P01.x: Appointment confirmed, delivery documents ready and insurance active from pick-up.

P02.x: The vehicle's VIN matches the order and the paperwork. Check it is the same in the app, the paperwork, on the car and in the system, and that any extra options are correct.

P03.x: Matches the paperwork; both plates are firmly fixed.

P04.x: Model, trim, colour, interior, wheels, seats and options match the order.

P05.x: Receive all planned key cards or fobs and confirm the number with the delivery team.

P06.x: Note both values; have enough charge for the first trip and for recharging. About 50 % is usually enough to leave: confirm enough range to reach your destination with a margin.

E01.x: No scratches, dents, pronounced swirls or visible inclusions. Also look for paint runs (drips), excessive orange peel, spots with no paint or bare metal (including stone chips) and dents. Use raking light for micro-scratches.
E01.tip: With a torch at an angle you can spot swirls and dust specks under the paint.

E02.x: Even tone; also check areas visible when opening doors and trunks.
E02.tip: Some cars had unpainted door interiors.

E03.x: Check fit of hood, doors, fenders and tailgate; look along the hood from the seat. Run your hand over doors, bonnet and tailgate: no noticeable steps. Even gaps, continuous body lines and a left/right comparison (or with other cars being delivered).

E04.x: No chips, cracks or scratches; check all installed glazing.

E05.x: Lenses clean, intact and seated; no water inside. Headlights at the same height and gap; daytime running lights (DRL) level and symmetrical; switch on the dipped beams to check even lighting.

E06.x: Seals seated, no folds, cuts or loose areas; check the roof perimeter. Trims and skirts without scratches and with no abnormal gaps at the joints; compare with the opposite side.
E06.tip: Look mainly at the seals between the glass roof and the body: they must not be twisted.

E07.x: Open and close all of them; check window fit where applicable. Smooth opening and closing, with no effort or noise; door handles evenly aligned.
E07.tip: When opening and closing, the window should drop and rise on its own without rubbing.

E08.x: No scuffs or damage; ask for help to check under the covers, if fitted.

E09.x: Sizes approved for this configuration; no cuts, bulges or deformations.

E10.x: Check cold against the vehicle label and manual; do not use a universal figure. Pressures consistent across all 4 tyres.

E11.x: No adhesive residue on handles or frames; check visible underside without crawling under.

I01.x: Check all rows: no cuts, stains, scratches or worn stitching.

I02.x: Surfaces, door panels and trim free of marks or loose parts. Centre console free of noises: raise and lower the armrest and lean your leg lightly against the console to listen for creaks or loose parts.

I03.x: No scratches or deformation; check the feel of buttons and scroll wheels.

I04.x: Surface and bezels unmarked; include instrument and rear screen, if any.

I05.x: Linings correctly fitted; no abnormal folds, stains or damage. Pillar (A/B/C) fabric (grey) free of stains.

I06.x: Glovebox, console, floors and linings clean; lids and latches in good condition.

I07.x: Included or ordered mats are present and secured without touching the pedals.

F01.x: Test daytime running, low beam, high beam and front fog, if fitted.

F02.x: Indicators, hazards, position, brake, reverse, plate and rear fog lights.

F03.x: Test ceiling, reading, courtesy, glovebox, trunks and door puddle lights, as equipped. Interior LEDs aligned.

F04.x: Operate all fitted: normal travel, no rubbing or abnormal noises.
F04.tip: On some models the rear ones only drop about 2/3: that is normal.

F05.x: Test the usual release of each door; locate the emergency release in the manual.

F06.x: Adjustment and folding if fitted; reverse tilt and return if enabled.

F07.x: Test opening and closing per the manual; ask for a demonstration if needed.
F07.tip: It opens from the screen, the app or by voice.

F08.x: Open and close; test powered or hands-free operation only if fitted.

F09.x: Test with doors closed and glass wet; check washer fluid.
F09.tip: Important: they only work with all doors closed.

F10.x: Briefly test the horn and the reverse warning sound, if fitted, in a safe place.

F11.x: Test manual or electric adjustments on every seat that has them.

F12.x: Test planned folding and return; check they latch.

F13.x: Buckle, unbuckle and check retraction on every seat; check child anchors.

F14.x: Test cooling, heating, fan and installed vents, including rear rows.

F15.x: Test seat heating or ventilation and steering wheel heating, if present.

F16.x: Check it turns on, is continuous and adjustable between dashboard and doors, if fitted.

F17.x: Test special doors, adjustable suspension or other ordered options with staff.

T01.x: Test brightness, touch and menus on installed screens; look for dead pixels.

T02.x: Image available in all installed views; check any pending alert or calibration. Image without distortion or visible obstructions.

T03.x: Test the speakers with balance; pair Bluetooth and check the microphone.

T04.x: Test installed ports and sockets; identify in the manual which carry data.
T04.tip: The glovebox one is usually the only one with data, the one Sentry uses to record.

T05.x: Test each charging pad with a compatible phone, if fitted.

T06.x: Vehicle visible in the app; test each key card or fob and the compatible phone key.

T07.x: Check location, route and purchased services; look for pending activations.

T08.x: Check the included USB drive and camera / Sentry recording available for your configuration.

C01.x: Flap opens and closes properly; connector clean with no visible damage.

C02.x: If a charger is available, start and stop a charge; check cable lock and release.

C03.x: Check the Type 2 cable and other included or purchased items: condition and connection without forcing.
C03.tip: If they give you a different-brand cable that is hard to plug in, ask for a Mennekes one (the usual blue).

C04.x: Locate the next stop and the recommended limit in the vehicle; check payment in the app. Confirm whether Tesla offers free charging or free Supercharging.

A01.x: Compare delivery with the order: mats, tray, cables and other agreed items.

A02.x: Check first-aid kit and vest if included; keep the vest within reach for the trip.

A03.x: Kit or planned solution; check sealant expiry and test the compressor without emptying the sealant.
A03.tip: Some compressors did not work: test it on the spot.

A04.x: Only if you will drive in Spain (mandatory there): carry a certified model, charged and valid.

A05.x: If ordered: hitch, keys, installation and accessories; ask staff to show how it fits.
A05.tip: The hitch socket is visible by removing the lower rear bumper cover (a coin works).

S01.x: Show every finding to the delivery team; keep photos and written confirmation.

S02.x: Agree what is fixed today, what needs an appointment and which checks remain.

S03.x: Understand gear selection, braking, lights and defogging; resolve safety alerts.

S04.x: Observe steering, braking, vibrations and noises at legal speeds; report anomalies.
S04.tip: Do a long trip in the first 10 days: some vibrations only appear at motorway speed.

S05.x: Keep the delivery record and confirm the final documentation.

D01.x: Bring both originals, valid. Tesla asks for them as a pre-delivery task in the app.
D01.tip: Check the name matches the order and contract exactly.

D02.x: You cannot drive away without valid insurance. Pre-arrange the policy and add the plate as soon as Tesla gives it to you.
D02.tip: The plate usually arrives the day before or the same day, sometimes 2 h earlier: warn your insurer or agent beforehand. Legal minimum: third-party liability.

D03.x: IRN form with boxes Q3 (buyer) and Q9 (signatures) filled in. If you do not bring it filled in, it is done at the centre.
D03.tip: Tesla usually emails it together with the Declaração de Venda. Ask whether you can bring it already filled in and signed.

D04.t: Declaração de Venda and IMT notification
D04.x: You receive Tesla's sales declaration and the IMT notification; keep them, they let you drive until the DUA arrives.
D04.tip: Ask how and when the final DUA will arrive.

D05.x: With a loan or lease they usually also ask for the lender's contract or paperwork. Bring a copy.
D05.tip: Confirm with the advisor and the bank exactly which documents are needed and whether the bank must sign the RRA.

D06.x: Name, tax ID and address correct on the contract, invoice and registration documents.
D06.tip: A mistake here delays registration: fix it before signing.

D07.x: App installed, account created and a card registered to pay at Superchargers. Check-in at the centre is done with your phone (QR code).

E12.x: Look for small paint blobs or patches with a different shine. Ask whether anything was repainted or polished before delivery and get it in writing.

E13.x: Look at the underside and bumpers without crawling under: knocks, scrapes or scratches from loading and unloading. Matters for the battery warranty. Also check the battery cover underneath: no scratches or damage.
E13.tip: In Portugal some deliveries were postponed over bumpers scratched in transport.

E14.x: Open the driver door and photograph the certification label (with VIN) and the tyre and loading label (pressures). Compare the VIN with the windshield and the screen.

T09.x: Note the version under Controls > Software and check no update is pending half-way. An OTA will likely arrive soon after.

T10.t: Drivers and key in the app
T10.x: Add every driver (Security & Drivers) and test the phone key and unlocking from the app before you leave.

T11.x: With a USB drive holding a TeslaCam folder in the data port, enable dashcam and Sentry, record a clip and play it back.

T12.x: Wheel centred on a straight road and the car does not pull to one side. If there are vibrations or pulling, log it in the app to check alignment.

A06.x: The Model 3 has no spare wheel and in most European markets no tyre repair kit either. Check what your car includes and plan to buy an inflator and kit.

A07.x: Confirm which cables your order includes: Type 2 cable and, if you bought it, the mobile connector (usually in a Tesla bag). Test they plug in without forcing.

S06.x: Log every defect in the Tesla app before accepting the car. Ask whether there is a deadline (in some markets e.g. 24 h or 160 km) to log defects afterwards.

S07.x: Do not sign acceptance until you finish the inspection. Pending defects must be written on the delivery document and you get a copy.

S08.x: Record a walk-around video and photograph odometer, VIN, labels and every defect before leaving the centre.

S09.t: If the car is shipped afterwards
S09.x: If you will ship it (e.g. by sea), keep photos of its current condition and ask the carrier for conditions, documents and battery level required.

E15.x: Open the frunk and check under and along the sides of the bonnet, and the inside of the lid. Also check the boot hinges and the tailgate struts area.

D08.x: If the RRA signature must be authenticated, have it certified by a solicitador, lawyer or notary before pick-up. If the buyer is a company, Q3 holds the company details and Q9 the signature of its representative.
D08.tip: Ask Tesla whether, in your case, signing at the centre is enough or you must bring it already certified.

M01.x: Book the date about 2 weeks ahead. With the plate and chassis number they usually accept the booking. Ship departures are usually on Fridays.
M01.tip: Indicative price given by the carrier: about €580 (to be confirmed).

M02.x: Hand the cables in at the place the carrier indicates (reference: Póvoa de Santa Iria, about €25), with contact, name and destination.

M03.x: Before transport, check that the cabin, frunk and boot are empty. Remove personal items, loose accessories and anything that should not stay in the car.

M04.x: Leave enough charge for transport and for driving the car off.
